title: Rate Card: Home Protection Plans Monthly Fees, Price Lock and Bundle Rate
content:
Monthly fees for the Home Protection Plans line, in US dollars per plan per month, with the price-lock, notice, term and bundle-rate figures that accompany each fee.

## Monthly fee by plan

| Plan | Monthly fee (USD) | Bundle credit rate (percent of the plan's own monthly fee) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | 5.99 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | 5.49 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | 6.49 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | 9.99 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | 16.99 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | 24.99 | 10.0% |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | 39.99 | 0.0% |

## Terms common to every plan on this card

| Term | Figure for every plan |
|---|---|
| Price lock: months after enrollment during which the monthly fee cannot change | 12 months |
| Notice before a change to the monthly fee | 30 calendar days |
| Minimum term | 0 months (month-to-month) |
| Number of protection plans active at one premise that qualifies for the bundle credit | 2 plans |

## Notes

- A minimum term of 0 months means the plan runs month-to-month.
- The bundle credit rate is a monthly credit expressed as a percent of each bundled plan's own monthly fee. A rate of 0.0% means the plan earns no bundle credit; on this card that is Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield.
- The bundle threshold is the same for every plan: 2 protection plans active at one premise.

## Points of reading

- *Most and least expensive.* Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield carries the highest fee on the card, 39.99; Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard the lowest, 5.49.
- *Price lock length.* Every plan has the same 12-month price lock and the same 30-day notice figure; neither varies by plan.
